name: const unsafe fn copy_from (self , src : NonNull < T > , count : usize) where T : Sized ,
rule: If T is not Copy, using both the values in the region beginning at src and the values in the region beginning at self is not guaranteed safe merely because copy_from creates a bitwise copy.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn copy_from (self , src : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > , count : usize) where T : Sized , }
